title: Introducing Timestral
claims: Official announcement identifies four model sizes and probabilistic multivariate forecasting with covariates.
notes: Publisher leaderboard claims are not Splyce measurements.

title: Official Timestral standalone inference
claims: Repository documents PyTorch-based CPU/GPU inference and separate code/weights licenses.
Listed checkpoint sizes exclude dependencies and runtime memory.
notes: README and source tree inspected; no installation.

title: Timestral 1.0 28M
claims: Official docs describe up to 32K timesteps, past-only/known-future covariates and quantile outputs.
notes: Model docs do not replace actual license text or calibration tests.

title: Timestral-28M Modified MIT LICENSE
claims: Actual weights license withholds rights above USD 20 million company/employer global consolidated revenue in the preceding month.
notes: Fetched raw license after browser blob access failed; restricted weights, excluded from an unrestricted OSS default; permitted independently supplied local use is a separate product contract, not a relicensing claim. Other checkpoints require independent review.

title: Pinned Timestral causal patches and quantiles
claims: Source implements masked value patches, causal normalization, learned decoder queries and monotone quantile construction.
notes: Source inspection does not prove numerical calibration.

title: Pinned Timestral multiblock forecasting
claims: Source feeds medians back between blocks, distinguishes covariate roles and supports local model directories/local_files_only.
notes: Source inspection only; refinement/capping and multiblock uncertainty require runtime tests.

title: Google TimesFM
claims: Repository documents pretrained patched forecasting and a TimesFM 2.5 200M path.
notes: Bounded alternative survey only; pin code/model/dependency licenses before adoption.

title: Chronos-2 and Chronos-Bolt
claims: Chronos-2 supports multivariate and covariate-informed forecasting; Bolt uses direct multistep quantiles.
notes: Cloud deployment examples are comparators; local assets/platform and exact rights remain unqualified.

title: Moirai and Uni2TS
claims: Primary project provides universal forecasting, fine-tuning and inference, with multiple Moirai versions.
notes: No architecture/rights inference across all model versions; bounded survey.

title: Granite time-series foundation models
claims: Primary project includes TinyTimeMixer forecasting candidates.
notes: Exact checkpoint horizon/frequency/rights and costs remain open.

title: Timer large time-series models
claims: Official project supplies generative pretrained time-series transformer research and checkpoints.
notes: No runtime, adaptation or exact model-license qualification; bounded survey.
